integrity: A path-independent analytical involution proves the all-size statement; finite exhaustive tests are supplementary, not an infinite certificate. Historical priority has not been independently verified.
scientific_limitations: Main statement is for strict upper records and finite exchangeable real vectors, preserving record heights but not timestamps; the covariance formula additionally requires iid atomless data. An earlier implicit permutation proof cannot be excluded.
title: Last-observation delay invariance for record values under exchangeability
